hooks.name: Secret Detection on Write
hooks.description: Scans for hardcoded secrets, AWS keys, tokens, and passwords before any file write operation to prevent credential leaks

action.command: cd /Users/admin/Documents/Proyectos/Runbook_Guardian && grep -rn --include="*.py" --include="*.yml" --include="*.yaml" --include="*.json" --include="*.toml" -E "(AWS_SECRET_ACCESS_KEY|AWS_ACCESS_KEY_ID|password\s*=\s*['\"][^'\"]+['\"]|token\s*=\s*['\"][^'\"]+['\"]|AKIA[0-9A-Z]{16}|sk-[a-zA-Z0-9]{48})" backend/ frontend/ scripts/ infrastructure/ 2>/dev/null && echo "WARNING: Possible secrets detected in code!" && exit 2 || echo "No secrets detected" && exit 0
